title: Refund Computation Note: Northgate Protect Accident Plan Cancellation Refund
content:
This note fixes the cancellation refund on a Northgate Protect Accident 2-Year, 3-Year or 4-Year plan canceled at the plan holder's request outside the full-refund window.

**Definitions.**

- **Cancellation date:** today.
- **Plan price kept:** the plan's one-time charges less any refunds already booked on the plan.
- **Coverage days:** the days from the coverage start date through the day before the coverage end date.
- **Unused coverage days:** the days from the day after the cancellation date through the day before the coverage end date (none once the cancellation date reaches that day), never more than the coverage days.
- **Used share:** one less the unused coverage days divided by the coverage days, never more than one.
- **Claim service fees still owed:** the service fees recorded on claim decisions dated less than one whole month before today. A claim approved on the cancellation date stays covered for its incident: its service fee is among the claim service fees still owed and is taken from the refund, and its repair is authorized after the cancellation under the repair rules.

**Refund clause.** The Accident plan cancellation refund is the plan price kept times the unused coverage days divided by the coverage days — equally, the plan price kept times one less the used share — less a cancellation fee equal to the lesser of the tier's cancellation fee percentage of the plan price kept and the tier's cancellation fee cap, less the claim service fees still owed, never below zero and never more than the plan price kept, rounded down to the cent.

**Order of assembly.** The counting start of the coverage days, the used share and the cancellation fee are settled first; the refund is then figured with them as the refund clause states; every charge that comes off is applied next and the result is never below zero; a rate that raises the refund is applied after that; and the refund is held to no more than the plan price kept and rounded down to the cent once at the end.

## Worked example on hypothetical figures

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Plan price kept | $160.00 |
| Coverage days (a two-year term with no 29 February) | 730 |
| Unused coverage days | 365 |
| Refund before charges: $160.00 times 365 divided by 730 | $80.00 |
| Cancellation fee: the lesser of 10 percent of $160.00 and $25.00 | $16.00 |
| Claim service fees still owed (one decision two weeks ago) | $29.00 |
| Refund, rounded down to the cent | $35.00 |

Had the claim service fees still owed been $70.00, the refund would be held at zero.
